marta_cs: Week0 check: CourierLane private deploy - audit forwarding not showing up in Splunk. S3 objects present but forwarder failing to assume role. Possibly trust policy/external-id mismatch. @carol_courierlane can you confirm the role ARN and external-id you provided?

carol_courierlane: Role ARN is arn:aws:iam::9876543210:role/redwood-forwarder, external-id we provided was CW-CL-2026. We got an assume-role error in our forwarder logs: 'AccessDenied: Not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRole'.

tom_infra: That error usually means the role trust policy doesn't include the Redwood service principal or the external-id constraint is missing/incorrect. Can you paste the trust policy snippet?

carol_courierlane: Trust policy currently: ```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"ec2.amazonaws.com"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]}
```

nina_sre: Yep that's the problem - it only allows EC2. For cross-account forwarders we need a Principal AWS ARN for our account (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root) or the specific role, plus an external-id condition if specified. Example trust snippet: ```json
{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-forwarder"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"sts:ExternalId":"CW-CL-2026"}}}```

marta_cs: Action items: 1) @carol update trust policy to permit arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-forwarder and include external-id condition; 2) @tom confirm forwarder IAM role name matches; 3) I'll mark a blocker on week0 health and note renewal-risk watch if we don't get events within 24h.

opsbot: Ticket CS-5012 created: "CourierLane forwarder assume-role failure - trust policy/external-id" https://redwood.internal/tickets/CS-5012

carol_courierlane: Updated trust policy and redeployed forwarder. Logs show assume-role success and a backlog replay started. I see events arriving in Splunk now.

tom_infra: Please confirm CloudTrail shows sts:AssumeRole success and no Deny events; this helps postmortem.

carol_courierlane: CloudTrail shows successful sts:AssumeRole at 2026-03-18T15:12:01Z. I'll add notes to our onboarding doc about the external-id requirement.

nina_sre: Adding a short checklist item to private-deploy runbook: validate trust policy Principal + external-id, verify assume-role via aws sts get-caller-identity after deploy.

marta_cs: Week0 health status moved from red to yellow. Renewal risk: minor but noted in account health with mitigation (runbook + 48h validation). Scheduling a 2-week follow-up.

carol_courierlane: Thanks all. Will ping if anything else crops up.
